events.title: 1000 wishlists, thank you!
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who stopped by the shop during Next Fest. Yokai Mart just passed 1000 wishlists! Obachan would bow, but her back hurts. Here’s what we’re working on now: At least three more yokai with their own stories More choices and customer stories The demo stays available, so if a friend hasn’t tried it yet, now’s a good time. See you in the store! Dominik & Oli

Here’s what’s new:End-of-day statistics screenNotebook pages for your regular customersPickup station and cashier employeeReworked decision screenImproved translationsVarious bugfixes and quality of life improvementsNext Fest starts October 19th. events.title: Yokai Mart runs on Steam Deck
events.summary: Dear friends,Great news! Yokai Mart runs beautifully on Steam Deck! We test every build directly on device, and the experience feels right at home on the handheld.Official Steam Deck verification is on our roadmap closer to full release. But if you want to play on the go, you're good to go.We're also putting the finishing touches on our Next Fest build, which brings new mechanics and a smoother overall experience. Can't wait for you to try it.Thank you for your support! More updates soon!Dominik
